title: Window functions: top N per group

objectives.text: Compute a per-row value over a group without collapsing rows, using OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
Return the top N rows per group by filtering ROW_NUMBER in an outer query or CTE
Explain how ROW_NUMBER, RANK and DENSE_RANK differ when rows tie
